description: Vercel AI SDK v5 streamText of one OpenAI chat answer with usage.
notes: Telemetry is enabled on the call. recordInputs and recordOutputs stay at their defaults, which record message content on spans. The model is openai.chat. The provider sets stream_options.include_usage. The mock waits 120 ms before the first chunk and splits the answer into 4 chunks. Two spans: streamText and doStream. Token counts are copied, including cachedInputTokens and reasoningTokens written as 0. The doStream span measures ai.response.msToFirstChunk, ai.response.msToFinish, and ai.response.avgOutputTokensPerSecond. ai.stream.msToFirstChunk is absent. ai.response.timestamp is the mock created_at, 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z.
